notes: RANK 2 for the dining room's back wall (Andrew, 2026-11-17: "Need a long, thin (depthwise) console for the dining room, looks too empty (same side wall where I'll place the clock)" and "Make sure when you pick the console it isn't too long such that it blocks the kallax that will be in the dining room"; asked which wall, "Back wall, by the last Kallax".). Walnut with three rattan-front drawers over an open shelf; anti-tip per its title; engineered wood. $119.49 (20% off the $149.99 list), 4.5 stars (260), Amazon's Choice, 50+ bought in the past month; ships from Amazon, sold by Luoxiao, free delivery Friday November 20 (read 2026-11-17); its other colors were not opened. Fit: the dining room's back wall has a 58 5/8" free run, from the kitchen walkway's edge (F-42, x 30) to 24" in front of the corner KALLAX's last cubes (F-32, x 88 5/8): leaves 11 3/8". Color: walnut ties the dining room to the living room's walnut pieces (the Decofy, the WOHOMO, the UGGLERUM) without twinning the fluted Decofy, and the rattan echoes the bamboo accents (F-68 (2), (6)). Flags: fits, anchor-required.
